_meta.sharedConstraint: Single game asset/module only, centered, complete object in frame, three-quarter orthographic-like view, plain light gray studio background, no landscape, no people, no text, no watermark. Historically accurate working-class Boston, August 1765, weathered materials, muted pewter/umber palette, no Victorian, modern, fantasy, or military elements. Tileable square module ends where applicable.
_meta.axes: After fitting: origin centered in X and Z, module sits on y=0 (min.y=0). X = primary tile-length / run axis, Z = depth/thickness, Y = height. Corner modules turn from +X wing into +Z wing sharing the origin corner post.
_meta.budgets: barrier/traversal <=5k tris & <=512px tex; infill <=20k tris & <=1024px tex; city-block 4-12k tris & <=1024px tex.
_meta.meshyPoly: barriers/traversal requested at 12000 Meshy polycount (decimated to <=5k); infill/city-block at 30000 (decimated to budget).
